column1: # Every GDScript call that loads or reads a path built at runtime, and the files it
# may reach: FILE<tab>CALL<tab>GLOBS (repo-relative, * crosses directories; - for a
# user:// path only; @ship for a ship by her name, which the selector follows to the
# ships the files its tests reach can name). tools/test_changed.py takes each as edges
# to those files, and its --check-sites (make guard-check) fails on a site missing
# here or gone from the code. Arguments that are a string literal, or a constant
# holding one, need no line: the literal is an edge of its own. A path given as an
# argument — a test's --hit=PATH — is a literal in its caller, an edge there.

column2: FileAccess.open(OUT if ship == DEFAULT_SHIP else SHIP_OUT % ship)
